form_analysis.feedback: Clear, concise laser vein removal aftercare form with numbered instructions. Covers essential post-procedure care including hygiene, sun protection, and activity restrictions. Good focus on compression therapy which is specific to vein treatments. Could be enhanced with more detailed timelines, expected healing stages, and comprehensive emergency protocols.

form_data.introduction: Following your recent laser vein removal treatment, the following aftercare instructions will help ensure a smooth and successful healing process. Please read the instructions carefully and follow them closely. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

numbered_sections.title: Keep the treated area clean
numbered_sections.content: Gently wash the treated area with soap and water and pat dry with a clean towel. Do not use any creams, lotions, or ointments on the treated area unless instructed to do so by your provider.

numbered_sections.title: Avoid sun exposure
numbered_sections.content: Protect the treated area from direct sun exposure for at least 2 weeks. If you must be in the sun, apply a high-SPF sunscreen and wear protective clothing to cover the treated area.

numbered_sections.title: Avoid hot baths, saunas, and steam rooms
numbered_sections.content: The heat from these activities can increase swelling and discomfort in the treated area. Take cool showers instead.

numbered_sections.title: Avoid physical activity
numbered_sections.content: Avoid strenuous physical activity for at least 24 hours after your treatment. This will help reduce swelling and discomfort in the treated area.

numbered_sections.title: Wear compression stockings
numbered_sections.content: Wear compression stockings as instructed by your provider. This will help reduce swelling and improve blood flow in the treated area.

numbered_sections.title: Report any changes
numbered_sections.content: If you notice any changes in the treated area, such as increased pain, redness, or swelling, please contact us immediately.

numbered_sections.title: Follow-up appointment
numbered_sections.content: Speak to your practitioner about a follow-up appointment to assess your healing progress. Please attend this appointment as scheduled.

form_data.closing_statement: Thank you for choosing us for your laser vein removal treatment. We wish you a smooth and successful healing process.

form_differences.format: Numbered list instead of bullet points
form_differences.content: More concise than other laser treatment forms
